verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents building and managing vector indexes and offers three quantization techniques (PQ, RaBitQ, SQ) that compress indexes, which is an index-type choice affecting memory and recall. It also supports forcing an exhaustive flat scan for exact ground-truth results, and branching lets you build and validate index configurations off main. Missing for 10: any evidence of HNSW graph parameters or other tunable index/query knobs (e.g., partition, probe or refine settings), explicit documentation of recall-vs-latency/memory tradeoffs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
